The '''SoroSuub SSK heavy blaster''' was a model of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. One such pistol was owned by [[Corso Riggs]], who gave it the name "[[Flashy]]," like he did to all of his weapons.
